sentences.en: There was nothing but an old chair in the room.
sentences.zh: 房间里只有一把旧椅子。

sentences.en: Please remove that chair because it is in the way.
sentences.zh: 请把那把椅子移开，挡路了。

sentences.en: Grandmother looks very comfortable in that chair beside the fire.
sentences.zh: 奶奶坐在火炉旁的那把椅子上看起来很舒服。

senses.zh: 椅子；讲座；（会议的）主席位；大学教授的职位
担任（会议的）主席；使…入座；使就任要职
